name: Scarlet Monastery
summary: In the northeastern hills of Tirisfal Glades, Scarlet Monastery shelters the Scarlet Crusade behind fortified walls. Once a peaceful sanctuary and a center of learning for the Church of the Holy Light, it now holds four wings where zealots train, torture captives, and wage war on outsiders.

sections.title: A Fallen Sanctuary
sections.body:
Before the Third War, the Scarlet Monastery was a proud seat of Lordaeron's priesthood, devoted to learning and enlightenment. Then the Scourge devastated the land. The surviving crusaders cleared the halls of undead and spiders, and made the archives and courtyards a fortified garrison.

Grief and fear hardened into suspicion. The Scarlet Crusade came to see every outsider as a carrier of the plague, living or undead, human or otherwise. In their eyes, such foes must be cleansed with fire.

sections.title: The Four Wings
sections.body:
Beyond the Grand Vestibule lie four wings. In the Graveyard, fallen crusaders rise as undead abominations, while torturers force confessions from prisoners. The Library holds theological and historical works, guarded by renegade mage Arcanist Doan and his hounds.

In the Armory, weaponmasters such as Herod train recruits to fight as disciplined warriors. Deep within the stronghold lies the Cathedral, the Crusade's heart. There, its leaders direct their campaign across the blighted north.

sections.title: The Fall of the High Inquisitor
sections.body:
Scarlet Commander Mograine commands the Cathedral's inner sanctum beside the monastery's true master, High Inquisitor Whitemane. Whitemane channels the Holy Light and can raise fallen champions. To her devotees, that power makes the garrison seem invincible.

Defeating Whitemane strikes at the Crusade's command in Tirisfal Glades. It breaks the aura of divine authority behind the monastery's zealotry. The Crusade's leaders are mortal, and its campaign against the Forsaken and neighboring lands is badly weakened.

faq.q: Why is the Scarlet Crusade hostile to living Alliance adventurers?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade has fallen into madness and paranoia. Its members see anyone without a crimson tabard as a possible carrier of the Scourge plague. They make no distinction between friend and foe, believing every outsider tainted and in need of purging before spreading corruption.

faq.q: What happens when you defeat High Inquisitor Whitemane?
faq.answer: Defeating High Inquisitor Whitemane deals a severe blow to the Scarlet Crusade's western leadership. As the monastery's spiritual leader, she raises the fallen and keeps Commander Mograine fighting at her side. Her death leaves the garrison disordered and weakens its threat to the surrounding region.

faq.q: What is the Scarlet Key and where is it found?
aliases: how to unlock armory and cathedral
faq.answer: Arcanist Doan keeps the Scarlet Key in his strongbox, deep in the Library wing behind his study. The key opens the outer gates of both the Armory and the Cathedral wings.

faq.q: Why is Arcanist Doan in the Scarlet Monastery?
faq.answer: Arcanist Doan is a powerful human mage who serves the Scarlet Crusade. He believes arcane magic is needed to cleanse the Scourge from Lordaeron. In his study, he guards the monastery's Library and the Scarlet Key.

faq.q: Who was Alexandros Mograine and how is he connected here?
faq.answer: Alexandros Mograine, the famed Ashbringer, was a legendary paladin of the Silver Hand and one of the Scarlet Crusade's founders. He founded it alongside High General Abbendis and Grand Inquisitor Isillien. His son Renault now commands the Cathedral with High Inquisitor Whitemane.

faq.q: What makes the Graveyard wing so different from the rest of the monastery?
faq.answer: The Graveyard reveals the monastery's fanaticism in a harsher light. Interrogator Vishas runs its torture chambers. In neglected crypts, fallen casters such as Bloodmage Thalnos harvest or manipulate the restless dead.

angles.text: The Scarlet Monastery was once a sacred seat of Lordaeron's priesthood and a center of learning. Its fall to crimson zealotry shows how devotion can curdle into madness.
The Scarlet Monastery began as a seat of the Church of the Holy Light. Its grand chapels show holy power wielded by mortals twisted by hatred and vengeance.
On the border of Tirisfal Glades, the Scarlet Monastery threatens the Forsaken. Its spies reach Deathknell, and its dungeons hold captured undead who are tortured.
The Library wing holds rare historical and theological works. Arcanist Doan, the Crusade's foremost arcanist, guards them.
